title: Counter-DECEIVR: Counterfactual Explanations for Deepfake Detectors using Detector-Guided Rectified Flow Inversion
abstract: arXiv:2611.34032v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep-learning-generated media are increasingly passed off as real, driving an arms race between image generators and deepfake detectors. Trust in the latter is limited by their often black-box nature; and, while region-based explanations can sometimes be extracted, these become less useful as generation quality improves. Counterfactual examples, which show the minimal change that flips a detector's decision, reveal what evidence drives a verdict, helping analysts decide whether to trust it. This work introduces Counter-DECEIVR (DEtector-guided reCtifiEd flow InVeRsion for counterfactuals), a novel training-free framework that generates counterfactual examples. Counter-DECEIVR steers latents in the velocity field of a rectified flow model using gradients from off-the-shelf deepfake detectors, without training a generator or adapting the detector; unlike prior methods, it requires no per-instance or per-detector fitting and no diffusion

translated_title: Counter-DECEIVR：使用检测器引导的整流流反演为深度伪造检测器生成反事实解释
translated_abstract: 深度学习生成的媒体内容越来越多地被冒充为真实内容，这引发了图像生成器与深度伪造检测器之间的军备竞赛。人们对检测器的信任受到其黑箱特性的限制；虽然有时可以提取基于区域的解释，但随着生成质量的提高，这类解释的作用越来越有限。反事实示例展示了使检测器决策发生翻转的最小改变，从而揭示是什么证据驱动了判定结果，帮助分析人员决定是否信任该检测器。本工作提出了Counter-DECEIVR（基于检测器引导的整流流反演反事实框架），这是一个新颖的免训练框架，用于生成反事实示例。Counter-DECEIVR利用现成深度伪造检测器的梯度，在整流流模型的速度场中引导潜变量，无需训练生成器或调整检测器；与以往方法不同，它不需要针对每个实例或每个检测器进行拟合，也不需要扩散……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出免训练框架Counter-DECEIVR，利用现成深伪检测器的梯度在整流流模型速度场中引导潜变量，无需针对每个实例或每个检测器进行拟合即可生成反事实解释。
en_tdlr: Counter-DECEIVR is a novel training-free framework that generates counterfactual explanations for deepfake detectors by steering latents in a rectified flow model's velocity field using gradients from off-the-shelf detectors, requiring no per-instance or per-detector fitting.
